description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different model layers for four language pair combinations: en&en (red solid line), en&es (blue solid line), en&el (green solid line), and en&bn (magenta solid line), as evaluated in the context of efficient multilingual expansion for large language models. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 23 in integer steps, representing the depth of the model’s layers. The y-axis, labeled “Similarity,” is scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.45, with major gridlines at intervals of 0.05. All four lines exhibit a similar trend: starting at low similarity (around 0.04–0.07 at Layer 0), rising to a peak near Layer 6 (with en&en reaching ~0.27, en&es ~0.25, en&el ~0.16, and en&bn ~0.15), then declining through the middle layers to a trough around Layer 20 (all near 0.05–0.08), before sharply increasing again in the final layers. The en&en line shows the highest similarity overall, especially in the final layers, where it surges to 0.44 at Layer 23. The en&es line follows a similar trajectory but remains slightly below en&en, reaching 0.27 at Layer 23. The en&el and en&bn lines remain lower throughout, with en&el peaking at ~0.16 and en&bn at ~0.15 in early layers, and both rising to ~0.30 and ~0.31 respectively by Layer 23.
